criteria.requirement: Add table_caption_mode="legacy"|"paragraph" to real HTML2Text table conversion, defaulting to compatibility. Paragraph mode separates each nonempty caption from surrounding content and the actual table header/data while preserving existing inline emphasis/link conversion, repeated/empty captions and normal header separator generation. Keep bypass_tables/ignore_tables semantics with readable captions, ordinary caption-free tables and default output unchanged; reject unknown strategy when a caption is encountered. Do not duplicate caption text, rewrite the header as a title or alter original regression fixtures.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
